title: Percutaneous Nephrostomy Versus Stent In Sepsis Trial
brief_summary: Randomized control trial to compare the efficacy and safety of percutaneous nephrostomy with retrograde ureteric stenting for emergency renal decompression in cases of obstruction and sepsis associated with ureteric calculi.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ureteric calculus with proximal hydronephrosis confirmed on CT KUB
* White cell count \>12,000mm3 and/or temperature \>38C

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncorrected coagulopathy
* Urethral or ureteric stricture disease
* Urinary diversion
* Pregnancy
